We'll also want to save these lists of genes in a nice table somewhere, so let's do that here. 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
signature_df <- gs_list_mouse[c("Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest", "M2_macs_vs_rest")] %>% 
  reduce(bind_cols) 
colnames(signature_df) <- c("Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest", "M2_macs_vs_rest")
write_tsv(signature_df, file.path(results_dir, "inflamm_monocyte_signature.tsv"))
```
:::


We'll also need to be converting back and forth from mouse and human genes. We'll use this dataframe that I generated from biomaRt previously to do so. 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mouse_human_genes <- readRDS(here("data", "mouse_human_genes.rds"))
human_mouse_key <- set_names(mouse_human_genes$MGI.symbol, mouse_human_genes$HGNC.symbol)
mouse_human_key <- set_names(mouse_human_genes$HGNC.symbol, mouse_human_genes$MGI.symbol)
```
:::


## Get TCGA data

I've downloaded all the TCGA from cBioPortal and extracted the `data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt` files for every study. Let's read those in. 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tcga_rna_list <- readRDS(here("data", "TCGA_pan_can_atlas_2018", "tcga_mega_rna_list.rds"))
tcga_clin_df <- read_tsv(here("data", "TCGA_pan_can_atlas_2018", "tcga_mega_clinical_patient.txt"))
tcga_sample_df <- read_tsv(here("data", "TCGA_pan_can_atlas_2018", "tcga_mega_clinical_sample.txt"))

patient_sample_key <- tcga_sample_df %>% 
    select(PATIENT_ID, SAMPLE_ID)
tcga_clin_df <- tcga_clin_df %>% 
    left_join(patient_sample_key)
```
:::


Given that the monocyte signature is mouse-derived, I think it makes sense to restrict the genes considered to the human homologs of genes which were detected in the single cell analysis. We can pull those from the Seurat object. 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
so_full <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
human_genes <- mouse_human_key[rownames(so_full)][!is.na(mouse_human_key[rownames(so_full)])]
human_genes <- unname(human_genes)
length(human_genes)
```

# Run ssGSEA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mutate_split_by_median <- function(.df, var_str, na.rm = FALSE) {
    .df %>% 
        mutate(split_by_median = ifelse(get(var_str) >= median(get(var_str), na.rm = na.rm), 
                                        "above/equal to median", 
                                        "below median"))
}

mutate_split_by_quartiles <- function(.df, var_str, na.rm = FALSE) {
    .df %>%
        mutate(
            split_by_quartiles = case_when(
                get(var_str) > quantile(get(var_str), 0.75, na.rm = na.rm) ~ ">Q3",
                get(var_str) > quantile(get(var_str), 0.5, na.rm = na.rm) ~ "Q2-Q3",
                get(var_str) > quantile(get(var_str), 0.25, na.rm = na.rm) ~ "Q1-Q2",
                TRUE ~ "<Q1"
                
            )
        ) %>% 
        mutate(split_by_quartiles = factor(split_by_quartiles, levels = c("<Q1", "Q1-Q2", "Q2-Q3", ">Q3")))
}
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gsva_res <-
    run_or_readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "ssGSEA_all.TCGA_myeloid_signatures.rds"),
                   function() {
                       gsva_out <- tcga_rna_list %>%
                           map_dfr( ~ {
                               new_df <- ..1 %>%
                                   filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% human_genes) %>%
                                   mutate(mouse_gene = human_mouse_key[Hugo_Symbol]) %>%
                                   dplyr::relocate(mouse_gene, .after = Hugo_Symbol) %>%
                                   dplyr::select(-Entrez_Gene_Id,-Hugo_Symbol) %>%
                                   group_by(mouse_gene) %>% 
                                   summarise_all(sum) %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("mouse_gene") %>% 
                                   as.matrix()
                               gsva(
                                   new_df,
                                   gset.idx.list = gs_list_mouse,
                                   method = "ssgsea",
                                   kcdf = "Gaussian",
                                   min.sz = 3
                               ) %>%
                                   as_tibble(rownames = "gs_name") %>%
                                   pivot_longer(
                                       cols = 2:ncol(.),
                                       names_to = "sample",
                                       values_to = "score"
                                   )
                           }, .id = "tumor_type")
                       
                       gsva_wide <- gsva_out %>%
                           group_by(gs_name) %>%
                           mutate(scaled_score = as.vector(scale(score))) %>%
                           ungroup() %>%
                           pivot_wider(
                               id_cols = c(tumor_type, sample),
                               names_from = gs_name,
                               values_from = c(score, scaled_score)
                           )
                       
                       return(gsva_wide)
                   })
```

```{.r .cell-code}
gsva_res_w_metadata <- gsva_res %>%
  left_join(tcga_clin_df, by = c("sample" = "SAMPLE_ID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OS_STATUS)) %>%
  mutate(OS_MONTHS = as.numeric(OS_MONTHS)) %>%
  mutate(OS_STATUS = as.integer(str_extract(OS_STATUS, "."))) %>%
  group_by(tumor_type) %>%
  mutate(inflamm_minus_m2 = scaled_score_Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest - scaled_score_M2_macs_vs_rest) %>%
  mutate(inflamm_minus_m2_scaled = as.vector(scale(inflamm_minus_m2))) %>%
  mutate(tumor_type_abbr = str_extract(tumor_type, "^.*_tcga") %>% str_sub(end = -6)) %>%
  drop_na(score_Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
survfit_inflamm_monocytes_list <- list()
survfit_inflamm_vs_m2_list <- list()
coxph_inflamm_monocytes_list <- list()
coxph_inflamm_vs_m2_list <- list()

for (tumor_type_str in unique(gsva_res_w_metadata$tumor_type)) {
  # print(tumor_type_str)
  
  if (nrow(gsva_res_w_metadata %>% filter(tumor_type == tumor_type_str)) == 0) {
    NULL
  } else {
    survfit_inflamm_monocytes_list[[tumor_type_str]] <- survfit(
      Surv(OS_MONTHS, OS_STATUS) ~ split_by_median,
      data = gsva_res_w_metadata %>%
        filter(tumor_type == tumor_type_str) %>%
        mutate_split_by_quartiles("score_Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest", na.rm = T) %>%
        mutate_split_by_median("score_Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest")
    )
    
    survfit_inflamm_vs_m2_list[[tumor_type_str]] <- survfit(
      Surv(OS_MONTHS, OS_STATUS) ~ split_by_median,
      data = gsva_res_w_metadata %>%
        filter(tumor_type == tumor_type_str) %>%
        mutate_split_by_quartiles("inflamm_minus_m2", na.rm = T) %>%
        mutate_split_by_median("inflamm_minus_m2")
    )
    
    coxph_inflamm_monocytes_list[[tumor_type_str]] <- coxph(
      Surv(OS_MONTHS, OS_STATUS) ~ scaled_score_Inflammatory_monocytes_vs_rest,
      data = gsva_res_w_metadata %>%
        filter(tumor_type == tumor_type_str)
    )
    
    coxph_inflamm_vs_m2_list[[tumor_type_str]] <- coxph(
      Surv(OS_MONTHS, OS_STATUS) ~ inflamm_minus_m2_scaled,
      data = gsva_res_w_metadata %>%
        filter(tumor_type == tumor_type_str)
    )
  }
  
}
coxph_inflamm_monocytes_df <-
  coxph_inflamm_monocytes_list %>% map_dfr(
    broom::tidy,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    .id = "name"
  )
coxph_inflamm_vs_m2_df <-
  coxph_inflamm_vs_m2_list %>% map_dfr(
    broom::tidy,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    .id = "name"
  )
```

CoxPH of all TCGA with the inflamm monocyte signature.

```{.r .cell-code}
count_df <- gsva_res_w_metadata %>%
    group_by(tumor_type_abbr) %>%
    summarise(n = n())
coxph_inflamm_monocytes_df %>%
    mutate(name = str_extract(name, "^.*_tcga") %>% str_sub(end = -6)) %>%
    left_join(count_df, by = c("name" = "tumor_type_abbr")) %>%
    mutate(name = paste0(name, " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(name, estimate, color = p.value < 0.05) +
    geom_point(shape = "square", size = 4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text(
        aes(y = Inf, label = sprintf("p=%s", format(p.value, digits = 1))),
        hjust = 1.1,
        vjust = 0,
        size = 2
    ) +
    geom_text(
        aes(y = Inf,
            label = sprintf(
                "(%s -- %s)",
                format(conf.low, digits = 1, scientific = F),
                format(conf.high, digits = 1, scientific = F)
            )),
        size = 1.5,
        hjust = 1.1,
        vjust = 1.5
    )+
    labs(x = "", y = "Hazard Ratio") +
    coord_flip()  +
    scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(0.2)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "black")) +
    theme(
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none"
    )
```
